title: Oort SDK contract case file
description: A file of cases. Each case runs on every transport it names, against a fresh store seeded from seeds/<seed>.json. Names are camelCase wire names; the Python runner converts them mechanically. In strings, ${name} is a value a step saved (a whole-string reference keeps the value itself), ${secret:<kind>} the text of a fixture secret of that kind (packages/core/test/fixtures/secrets.b64.txt), and ${repeat:<n>:<c>} the character c repeated n times. Matchers: $type, $len, $some, $every, $none, $absent, $regex, $approx (with $tol). Unknown result fields are ignored. After every step, no fixture secret may appear in the result or error.

options.description: createOort options; the runner adds mode, home, cwd, env, fetch and keySources.

adapters.description: none: no model adapters and no keys (local).

counter.description: Today's count in the shared agent judgment counter (judge-mcp-count.json).

memories.description: Extra bulk memories in the fake cloud.

endUsers.description: Per-user memory (CON-132): server-key, the key acts for end users (whoami lists end-users); legacy, an Oort Cloud from before it, which ignores Oort-User. Absent: a current cloud and a key without the capability.

fail.description: Forced fake-cloud failures by route ('METHOD /path', :id matches one segment): a status, {status, code}, 'network' or 'garbage'.

on.description: A handle a scoped step saved with 'as'; default the root.
